baselineDisplay.title: 探测器寻宝记
baselineDisplay.text:
【故事复现】探测器寻宝记
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: What did the team find?
问题：探险队发现了什么？
• 词汇准备
• mine 矿
• treasure 财宝
• revealer 探测器
• invent 发明
• detect 探测
• bury 埋藏
• seashore 海岸
• pirate 海盗
• arm 武装
• soil 泥土
• worthless 毫无价值的
• thoroughly 彻底地
• trunk 箱子
• confident 有信心的
• value 价值
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。
Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
最近，找到失踪宝藏的梦想差一点儿变成现实。
A new machine called ‘The Revealer’ has been invented and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
一种叫“探宝器”的新机器已经发明出来，并被人们用来探测地下埋藏的金子。
The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where —it is said— pirates used to hide gold.
在靠近海边的一个据说过去海盗常在里面藏金子的岩洞里，这种机器被派上了用场。
The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
海盗们过去常把金子埋藏在那个洞里，可后来却没能取走。
Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
一支用这种新机器装备起来的探宝队进入了这个岩洞，希望找到埋藏着的金子。
The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
当这个队的队长正在检查洞口附近的土壤时，那台机器显示出它的下面埋有金子。
Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep. They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
队员们异常激动，就地挖了一个两英尺深的坑，但最后找到的是一枚几乎一钱不值的小金币。
The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
队员们接着又把整个洞彻底搜寻了一遍，但除了一只空铁皮箱外什么也没找到。
In spite of this, many people are confident that ‘The Revealer’ may reveal something of value fairly soon.
尽管如此，很多人仍然相信“探宝器”很快就会探出值钱的东西来。
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Is “The Revealer” a new machine or an old machine? Is it used for detecting buried gold or not? (which)
2 Did a search party use this machine or not? Where did they find gold recently? (Using this machine...)
3 Did they examine the cave thoroughly or not? Did they only find a small gold coin? Was it valuable or was it practically worthless? (Although...which)
4 Do many people believe that the machine may reveal something of value soon or not? (However)
Answer: “The Revealer” is a new machine which is used for detecting buried gold. Using this machine, a search party recently tried to find gold in a cave near the seashore. Although they examined the cave thoroughly, they only found a small gold coin which was practically worthless. However, many people believe that the machine may reveal something of value soon.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。
1 The search party was looking for _______.
(a) gold
(b) a gold mine
(c) pirates
(d) a tin trunk
2 The search for gold proved that 'The Revealer' _________.
(a) works very well
(b) doesn't work well
(c) is quite useless
(d) isn't very good
3 ‘The Revealer’ has been used for _______ gold.
(a) to detect
(b) detecting
(c) detect
(d) detected
4 Pirates used to hide gold there, __________.
(a) and they always do
(b) and they still do
(c) and they still do sometimes
(d) that's what they would do
5 They hoped to find buried treasure. They hoped they _______ it.
(a) would find
(b) had found
(c) will find
(d) are going to find
6 Where did they ________ the hole?
(a) dig
(b) digging
(c) dug
(d) have dug
7 How ________ was the hole?
(a) deeply
(b) depth
(c) deep
(d) down
8 ‘The Revealer’ is very good _________.
(a) machine
(b) engine
(c) machinery
(d) mechanic
9 The leader of the party was examining the soil. He was ________.
(a) testing it
(b) looking at it carefully
(c) watching it
(d) trying it
10 The coin was almost worthless. So it was of small __________.
(a) worthy
(b) honour
(c) price
(d) value
11 They searched the cave thoroughly They searched it
(a) completely
(b) across
(c) inside
(d) finally
12 Some people are confident. They ________ the machine will be useful.
(a) confide
(b) believe
(c) confuse
(d) confess
Key: 1 a 2 a 3 b 4 d 5 a 6 a 7 c 8 a 9 b 10 d 11 a 12 b
第四十四单元【语法点拨】 关系副词引导的定语从句
▶ 关系副词 when, where, why 引导的定语从句
在表示时间、地点和原因的限制性及非限制性定语从句中,可以用 when, where 和 why 来代替介词+关系代词，when 和 where 相当于“介词+ which”，why 相当于“for+ which”，在句中均作状语。
• 1976 was the year when (=in which) my daughter was born.
1976 年是我女儿出生的那一年。
• The summer of 1969, when (=during which) men first set foot on the moon, will never be forgotten.
1969 年夏是人们永远不会忘记的，这一年人类第一次登上了月球。
• This is the place where(=in which) I grew up. 这是我长大的地方。
• The Tower of London, where (=in which) so many people lost their lives, is now a tourist attraction.
在伦敦塔中曾有许多人丧命，它现在是旅游胜地。
• This is the reason why (=for which) he was dismissed from office.
这就是他被罢官的原因。
• My success in business, the reason why (= for which) he dislikes me, has been due to hard work.
他因我在事业上的成功而不喜欢我，我的成功归功于我努力工作。
▶ 关系副词 that 引导的定语从句
用 that 代替 when, where, why 只能用在限制性定语从句中，that 有时可以省略。
• I still remember the summer that(=when= during which) we had the big flood.
我仍然记得我们遭遇大洪灾的那个夏天。
• Never shall I forget the day that(=when=on which) I first came to this university. 我永远不会忘记我第一次来到这所大学的那一天。
• That is the place that(= where= at which) he stayed when he was in Shanghai.
那是他在上海住过的地方。
• The reason that (=why= for which) he dropped out was that his family was too poor.
他辍学的原因是他家太贫穷。
• This is the manner that (=in which) they act.
这就是他们做事的方法。
▶ 关系副词 where 和 when 引导的非限制性定语从句
关系副词 where 和 when 引导的非限制性定语从句，通常由逗号将主句和从句隔开,对主句作补充说明，注意不要同状语从句相混淆。
• After graduation, I decided to stay in Shanghai, where I spent my childhood and four years of college life.
毕业后，决定留在上海，在那里我曾度过了童年和四年大学生活
• Albert Einstein left Germany for the United States during World War Two, when Jews were badly treated in Germany.
第二次世界大战期间，爱因斯坦离开德国去了美国，那时犹太人在德国受到了迫害。

▶ 关系副词 when, where, why 引导的定语从句
when 和 where 可引导限制性或非限制性定语从句，分别说明时间和地点，常可改写成合适的“介词 + which”。why 通常在 reason 后引导限制性定语从句，相当于 for which；不能把 why 任意用于非限制性定语从句。
• 1976 was the year when (=in which) my daughter was born.
1976 年是我女儿出生的那一年。
• The summer of 1969, when (=during which) men first set foot on the moon, will never be forgotten.
1969 年夏是人们永远不会忘记的，这一年人类第一次登上了月球。
• This is the place where(=in which) I grew up. 这是我长大的地方。
• The Tower of London, where (=in which) so many people lost their lives, is now a tourist attraction.
在伦敦塔中曾有许多人丧命，它现在是旅游胜地。
• This is the reason why (=for which) he was dismissed from office.
这就是他被罢官的原因。
• My success in business, the reason why (= for which) he dislikes me, has been due to hard work.
他因我在事业上的成功而不喜欢我，我的成功归功于我努力工作。
辨析：逗号之间的 the reason why he dislikes me 是对 My success in business 的名词性补充说明；其中 why 从句修饰 reason，本身不是非限制性定语从句。
▶ 某些定语从句中 that 与关系副词的用法
在表示时间、原因等的某些限制性定语从句中，可以使用 that 或省略关系词。place 后这种用法较口语化；不能据此把任意地点名词后的 where 都换成 that。
• I still remember the summer that(=when= during which) we had the big flood.
我仍然记得我们遭遇大洪灾的那个夏天。
• Never shall I forget the day that(=when=on which) I first came to this university. 我永远不会忘记我第一次来到这所大学的那一天。
• That is the place that(= where= at which) he stayed when he was in Shanghai.
那是他在上海住过的地方。
• The reason that (=why= for which) he dropped out was that his family was too poor.
他辍学的原因是他家太贫穷。
• This is the way that (=in which) they act.
这就是他们做事的方法。
▶ 关系副词 where 和 when 引导的非限制性定语从句
关系副词 where 和 when 可引导非限制性定语从句，通常用逗号隔开，对前面的地点或时间提供补充信息；注意与状语从句区分。
• After graduation, I decided to stay in Shanghai, where I spent my childhood and four years of college life.
毕业后，我决定留在上海，在那里我曾度过了童年和四年大学生活。

blocks.text: 【故事复现】探测器寻宝记
• Step 1: Listen and answer the question.
第一步：听 Freya 慢速朗读的故事，回答下列问题。
Question: What did the team find?
问题：探险队发现了什么？
• 词汇准备
• mine 矿
• treasure 财宝
• revealer 探测器
• invent 发明
• detect 探测
• bury 埋藏
• seashore 海岸
• pirate 海盗
• arm 武装
• soil 泥土
• worthless 毫无价值的
• thoroughly 彻底地
• trunk 箱子
• confident 有信心的
• value 价值
• Step 2: Intensive reading.
第二步：故事精读。

Dreams of finding lost treasure almost came true recently.
最近，找到失踪宝藏的梦想差一点儿变成现实。

A new machine called ‘The Revealer’ has been invented and it has been used to detect gold which has been buried in the ground.
一种叫“探宝器”的新机器已经发明出来，并被人们用来探测地下埋藏的金子。

The machine was used in a cave near the seashore where—it is said—pirates used to hide gold.
在靠近海边的一个据说过去海盗常在里面藏金子的岩洞里，这种机器被派上了用场。

The pirates would often bury gold in the cave and then fail to collect it.
海盗们过去常把金子埋藏在那个洞里，可后来却没能取走。

Armed with the new machine, a search party went into the cave hoping to find buried treasure.
一支用这种新机器装备起来的探宝队进入了这个岩洞，希望找到埋藏着的金子。

The leader of the party was examining the soil near the entrance to the cave when the machine showed that there was gold under the ground.
当这个队的队长正在检查洞口附近的土壤时，那台机器显示出它的下面埋有金子。

Very excited, the party dug a hole two feet deep. They finally found a small gold coin which was almost worthless.
队员们异常激动，就地挖了一个两英尺深的坑，但最后找到的是一枚几乎一钱不值的小金币。

The party then searched the whole cave thoroughly but did not find anything except an empty tin trunk.
队员们接着又把整个洞彻底搜寻了一遍，但除了一只空铁皮箱外什么也没找到。

In spite of this, many people are confident that ‘The Revealer’ may reveal something of value fairly soon.
尽管如此，很多人仍然相信“探宝器”很快就会探出值钱的东西来。
• Step 3: Listen again and answer the questions.
第三步：再听一遍，回答下列问题。
1 Is “The Revealer” a new machine or an old machine? Is it used for detecting buried gold or not? (which)
2 Did a search party use this machine or not? Where did they find gold recently? (Using this machine...)
3 Did they examine the cave thoroughly or not? Was the only gold they found a small coin? Was it valuable or was it practically worthless? (Although...which)
4 Do many people believe that the machine may reveal something of value soon or not? (However)

Answer: “The Revealer” is a new machine which is used for detecting buried gold. Using this machine, a search party recently tried to find gold in a cave near the seashore. Although they examined the cave thoroughly, the only gold they found was a small coin which was practically worthless; they also found an empty tin trunk. However, many people believe that the machine may reveal something of value soon.
• Exercise: Sentence structure and vocabulary.
课外练习：句型及词汇训练。

(d) down

(a) machine
(b) engine
(c) machinery
(d) mechanic

9 The leader of the party was examining the soil. He was ________.
(a) testing it
(b) looking at it carefully
(c) watching it
(d) trying it

(a) worthy
(b) honour
(c) price
(d) value

第四十四单元【语法点拨】 关系副词引导的定语从句
▶ 关系副词 when, where, why 引导的定语从句
when 和 where 可引导限制性或非限制性定语从句，分别说明时间和地点，常可改写成合适的“介词 + which”。why 通常在 reason 后引导限制性定语从句，相当于 for which；不能把 why 任意用于非限制性定语从句。

• 1976 was the year when (=in which) my daughter was born.
1976 年是我女儿出生的那一年。

• The summer of 1969, when (=during which) men first set foot on the moon, will never be forgotten.
1969 年夏是人们永远不会忘记的，这一年人类第一次登上了月球。
• This is the place where(=in which) I grew up. 这是我长大的地方。

• The Tower of London, where (=in which) so many people lost their lives, is now a tourist attraction.
在伦敦塔中曾有许多人丧命，它现在是旅游胜地。

• This is the reason why (=for which) he was dismissed from office.
这就是他被罢官的原因。

• My success in business, the reason why (= for which) he dislikes me, has been due to hard work.
他因我在事业上的成功而不喜欢我，我的成功归功于我努力工作。
辨析：逗号之间的 the reason why he dislikes me 是对 My success in business 的名词性补充说明；其中 why 从句修饰 reason，本身不是非限制性定语从句。
▶ 某些定语从句中 that 与关系副词的用法
在表示时间、原因等的某些限制性定语从句中，可以使用 that 或省略关系词。place 后这种用法较口语化；不能据此把任意地点名词后的 where 都换成 that。

• I still remember the summer that(=when= during which) we had the big flood.
我仍然记得我们遭遇大洪灾的那个夏天。
• Never shall I forget the day that(=when=on which) I first came to this university. 我永远不会忘记我第一次来到这所大学的那一天。

• That is the place that(= where= at which) he stayed when he was in Shanghai.
那是他在上海住过的地方。

• The reason that (=why= for which) he dropped out was that his family was too poor.
他辍学的原因是他家太贫穷。

• This is the way that (=in which) they act.
这就是他们做事的方法。
▶ 关系副词 where 和 when 引导的非限制性定语从句
关系副词 where 和 when 可引导非限制性定语从句，通常用逗号隔开，对前面的地点或时间提供补充信息；注意与状语从句区分。

• After graduation, I decided to stay in Shanghai, where I spent my childhood and four years of college life.
毕业后，我决定留在上海，在那里我曾度过了童年和四年大学生活。

• Albert Einstein moved to the United States in 1933, when the Nazis were persecuting Jews in Germany.
1933年，爱因斯坦移居美国；当时纳粹正在德国迫害犹太人。
史实校正：他于1933年赴普林斯顿高等研究院任职，并非在第二次世界大战期间才赴美。
